notes:
A big refresh: a cleaner Settings, new wallpapers, smoother motion everywhere, and automatic updates.

### TV Guide

- **Recent:** A new group at the top with the last 10 channels you watched.
- **Groups list:** The highlighted group is no longer faded or cut off while the list scrolls.
- **On or off:** Turn the whole TV Guide off in Settings › TV Guide if you don't use it; its dock tile, live channels in Search and Back to TV go away with it.
- **Switching groups:** The new group's rows slide into place one after another.

### Search

- **Apps:** An app opens straight from the results without Home showing first, and Back returns to your results.
- **On now:** Channel cards match the TV Guide, with the channel logo, the show, the time left and a progress bar.

### Home

- **Banner:** The picture blends smoothly into the next title.
- **Posters:** The highlighted poster lifts with a deep shadow and a quick light sweep, and the others dim.
- **Loading:** Posters show a soft shimmer while they download.
- **Start:** Home settles in, section by section, when Orbelle starts or the TV wakes up.
- **Profile:** Your picture is on Home; select it to change your name, picture or color.

### All apps

- **Opening:** All apps grows out of its dock button and shrinks back into it.
- **Few apps:** With 12 apps or fewer, the apps sit centered in balanced rows with every name showing.
- **Coming back:** The app you return from glows briefly, so you always know where you are.

### Wallpapers

- **Nature:** Four new wallpapers, Mirror Lake, Dunes, Coast and Northern Lights, each with day, sunset and night looks that follow the sun.
- **Classic:** Aurora, Ocean, Ember and Graphite are redone in frosted glass.

### Settings

- **New look:** Settings are grouped in frosted glass panels with section headers and simple white icons.
- **One profile:** Settings › Profile holds your name, picture, color, a PIN for Settings and the greeting; switching profiles and "Who's watching?" are gone.
- **Recommendations:** The choices are now All, Kids, Movies, Series and Your genres.
- **Update Orbelle:** Now includes About: your version, the update status, your device and Android version.
- **What's new:** Shows every change in the newest version, grouped by area, with earlier versions below.
- **Motion:** Choose Fast, Normal, Slow or Off.

### Control Center

- **Header:** Your picture, name and greeting, with the time and date.
- **Panel:** Frosted glass, only as tall as what's in it, opening with a soft spring.
- **Display:** The Display mode button has a new HDR icon.

### Motion

- **One style:** Full screens (TV Guide, Search, More info, Settings and All apps) zoom in, side panels spring in, popups scale up quickly, and closing is a little quicker than opening.

### Updates and performance

- **Automatic updates:** Orbelle downloads a new version while the TV is on and installs it while the TV sleeps (Android 12 and newer); choose Automatic, Notify only or Off in Settings › Update Orbelle.
- **Lite mode:** Also turns off the light sweep, the shimmer and the zooms, for the lightest feel.
- **Low-memory boxes:** A lighter blur, less memory for pictures and the TV Guide, and a quicker return to Home on 2 GB TV boxes.
- **Wi-Fi:** Turn on Wi-Fi opens the TV's Wi-Fi settings right away on newer Android versions.
- **Animations:** Orbelle keeps its own animation speed even when the TV's animation scale was changed.

history.notes:
Back from an app you opened in All apps now takes you back to All apps.

- **All apps:** Pressing Back in an app you opened from All apps returns to All apps, still on that app, so you can pick another one right away; the Home button still takes you to the home screen.

Apps open straight from All apps, without the home screen showing in between.

- **All apps:** The app you pick now opens directly over All apps, which closes behind it once the app is on screen, so Home no longer flashes before the app appears.

A more polished TV Guide: clearer logos, complete channel names, a softer highlight and easier number entry.

- **Channel list:** Channel numbers move to the show info at the top, so the list shows each logo and its full name, on two even lines when needed; a name too long even for that gets slightly smaller text instead of being cut.
- **Logos:** Logos are a little bigger, on a light tile when the logo is dark and a dark tile when it's light, so every logo is easy to see.
- **Highlight:** The show you're on gets a lighter charcoal with a thin white outline instead of solid white, so long shows don't look heavy.
- **Channel numbers:** Typing a number on the remote now works up to 5 digits, and if that channel isn't in your group, the guide switches to All channels to show it.

New versions show up in Update Orbelle as soon as they're published.

- **Updates:** Update Orbelle now reads the newest release directly, so it no longer says Up to date for a few minutes after a new version comes out, and it always downloads that newest APK.

Channel names read better from the couch.

- **Channel names:** Long names in the TV Guide now stay at full size and wrap to a second line instead of getting smaller.

Cleaner channel names in the TV Guide, no more channels stuck on Loading, and a smoother groups list.

- **Channel names:** The guide's channel column hides country and quality tags (like "USA" and "HD") and uses a second line when a name is long, so names show in full; the show info keeps the full name.
- **Guide loading:** Schedules that fail to load are tried again twice, and a channel with no answer shows "No guide info" instead of staying on Loading.
- **Groups list:** After hiding a group the highlight stays in place, and the list no longer scrolls over the GROUPS title.

The TV Guide shows what's on now more cleanly, and the groups list moves smoothly again.

- **Now in the guide:** The line across the shows is gone; each show on now has a thin pink progress bar, and a small time pill marks now on the time bar without covering the times.
- **Groups list:** Fixed the highlight getting stuck on All channels; Up and Down now move through every group.

A redesigned TV Guide in the style of TiviMate, with a groups list, favorites and pinned groups, plus a new default dock.

- **TV Guide:** A new layout with the show's info and a live preview on top, progress bars on the shows on now, and bigger, easier-to-read channel rows.
- **Groups:** A slim strip shows the group you're in; press Left on the show that's on now to open the groups list, where you can switch, move, pin to the top or hide groups.
- **Channel menu:** Hold OK on a show to watch it (or set a reminder), add the channel to Favorites (marked with a ★) or move it to another group.
- **Navigation:** Back jumps to what's on now on the same channel before closing, and Up and Down stop at the first and last items.
- **Dock:** The default order is now TV Guide, Nuvio TV, SmartTube, Spotify and Unlinked, set once on each profile; missing apps are skipped.
- **Cleanup:** Removed code left over from earlier Home and guide designs, so Orbelle stays small.

Moving between Home's banner and the posters now feels more natural.

- **Home:** Pressing Down on the banner's buttons goes back to the poster the banner is showing, instead of the poster right below.

Home's banner now steps aside while you're in the dock.

- **Home:** When an app or TV Guide in the dock is highlighted, the banner fades out and your wallpaper shows; it comes back when you move up to the posters.

Settings is steadier to move around, and long lists like Move to group are cleaner.

- **Settings:** Up on the first row and Down on the last row now stay put, on both the menu and the page; only Left and Right move between them.
- **Move to group:** The list scrolls in its own area with soft edges, shows each group's channel count, marks where the channel is now, and keeps Cancel fixed at the bottom.

TV Guide moves to the dock, Home gets simpler, and the guide's preview plays reliably.

- **Dock:** TV Guide is now the first tile in the dock, set apart from your apps by a divider, with a LIVE badge.
- **Home:** The Live TV row is gone, so Home shows the banner, the trending posters and the dock at full size.
- **TV Guide preview:** Fixed the preview window staying empty on some TVs; if a preview has no picture after a few seconds, Orbelle tries the channel's regular stream.
- **Channels:** TV Guide now loads up to 20,000 channels (up from 8,000).
